rules: Keep exact source and stage bindings; a repeated operation can have a different evidence-bound outcome.
Read each opener and reply with the follow-up; retain all domain payload.
Historical replies remain claims, external references remain explicit limits.
Do not add this cohort to independent-human or substitution denominators.

sequences.opener: Review three peer records, plan repairs and implement
sequences.intent: Resolve storage/access causes without deletion or safeguard bypass, then execute the existing plan through its existing owners.
sequences.outcome: The reply reports restored existing-worktree access, one merged healthcheck fix and two published Limen updates; heavy verification, deployment and full recovery remain incomplete.
sequences.limit: Three opener attachments were referenced but not read in this tranche; do not claim their complete contents reviewed.

sequences.opener: Close out a review whose checkout disappeared
sequences.intent: Derive the minimum actual human action from current access/ownership evidence; investigation and repair remain agent work.
sequences.outcome: The reply says there is no terminal command to run yet and describes a concrete policy request that still needs preparation.
sequences.limit: A prospective approval request is not approval, admission or a proven repair.

sequences.opener: Inventory agent directories and plan provider-neutral containment
sequences.intent: Adversarially evaluate the entire preceding session against its original multi-part request, source claims, coverage and durable deliverables.
sequences.outcome: The reply identifies incomplete census/plan delivery and unsafe recovery assumptions while preserving successful reconnaissance as partial evidence.
sequences.limit: This study reads the retained request/reply sequence; it does not re-audit every filesystem and external claim in that historical review.

sequences.opener: Repair strict YAML lint while preserving configuration values
sequences.intent: Check archival eligibility of the work conversation, without deleting the chat or authorizing checkout retirement.
sequences.outcome: The reply permits chat archival but says formal session closeout and a terminal receipt remain unverified.
sequences.limit: A yes answer to archival eligibility does not establish a passing formal release predicate.

sequences.opener: Finish incomplete local-CI fixes and integration
sequences.intent: Check chat archival eligibility against published work and remaining owned state.
sequences.outcome: The reply permits chat archival while requiring worktree retention because an uncommitted child edit has unknown ownership.
sequences.limit: Conversation archival and custody-qualified deletion have different predicates.

sequences.opener: Harden the native Doctor adapter and prove its deployed behavior
sequences.intent: Check archival eligibility as a durable handoff while preserving the unmerged delivery owner and private evidence.
sequences.outcome: The reply permits archival, reports a matching installed helper and published clean checkout, and explicitly retains the worktree with its PR still open.
sequences.limit: Archival as a handoff does not prove merge or authorize deleting source/evidence.

sequences.opener: Finish live skills consolidation, use, capture and rollback
sequences.intent: Derive the complete remaining rollout sequence with all consumer, capture, review, recovery and retirement gates preserved.
sequences.outcome: The reply gives a controlled five-consumer rollout and distinguishes engineering from eligible-review/account authority.
sequences.limit: This opener matches another reviewed view in wording; source/turn lineage must be reconciled before counting independent intentions.

sequences.opener: Give evidence-grounded feedback on day-to-day operation
sequences.intent: Finish the already requested activity analysis using its bounded evidence sample.
sequences.outcome: The reply provides the assessment and recommendations with explicit sample coverage rather than a complete time-use audit.
sequences.limit: Continuation can finish an analytical response; it does not authorize implementing its recommendations or altering schedules.

sequences.opener: Recover production and deployment automation under exact-source constraints
sequences.intent: Derive next work, assess serialized multi-agent preparation/execution, and draft a separate bounded relay for each role.
sequences.outcome: The reply supplies three role handoffs with temporal, authority, custody, accounting and full-day acceptance dependencies.
sequences.limit: Drafting handoffs does not reserve capacity, spawn agents, send messages, schedule future execution or prove deployment/recovery.

sequences.intent: Correct one-off cleanup into durable recurrence prevention, retaining the existing archive/restoration owner and original data.
sequences.outcome: The reply supplies a preventive maintenance plan and corrects the supplied claim that an archive process was running.
sequences.limit: The supplied operational assertion remains a claim; a plan is not preventive deployment or restored native history.

sequences.opener: Diagnose quota and two MCP startup failures
sequences.intent: Execute only the specifically selected technical repair: negotiation compatibility and a prepared fixed-version launcher.
sequences.outcome: The reply reports tool discovery for both integrations but leaves full installer completion and independent monthly quota exhaustion open.
sequences.limit: Permission to fix MCP startup does not authorize paid quota changes or make a still-running installer terminal.

sequences.opener: Proceed with the named C0 reconciliation stage
sequences.intent: Repeat the same C0-stage request while retaining its source prerequisites, accepted policy boundaries and existing allowance.
sequences.outcome: The first reply cannot locate B0; the second reports C0 staged on B0 with tests and HOLD for acceptance/review.
sequences.limit: The repeated instruction alone does not prove B0 was found, authorize unrelated extraction, waive prerequisites or adopt policy.

sequences.opener: Build a purpose-specific governed repository factory
sequences.intent: Resolve this session's obligations and prove its release without substituting project completion or merge acceptance.
sequences.outcome: The reply reports two unchanged passing release runs while explicitly leaving task completion, estate completion, retirement and merge unclaimed.
sequences.limit: Historical release claims are preserved as such; this study does not rerun the old predicate.

sequences.intent: Supply the new local-run error as evidence that tests the earlier Codespaces-specific hypothesis.
sequences.outcome: The reply identifies the same transcription challenge locally and gives a redacted escalation route rather than a microphone/reinstall fix.
sequences.limit: The error attachment is not fully read here. No challenge tokens or personal log material are reproduced; no feedback is submitted by this study.

sequences.intent: Attempt the complete original session-release contract, preserving its task owners and custody requirements.
sequences.outcome: The reply reports exit 2/unmeasured after bootstrap and a read-back handoff; release remains unverified.
sequences.limit: The same closeout operation as E13 can return a different result because evidence differs.

sequences.opener: Plan healing of an allegedly missing closeout protocol
sequences.intent: Prove release for this healing session while retaining the prior plan and original session obligations separately.
sequences.outcome: The reply reports exit 0 and a published durable handoff after the earlier reply identified a partly stale blocker.
sequences.limit: This response does not by itself prove every original foreign-session task predicate passed.
